text: Use the requested canvas and delivery surface. If unspecified, infer a useful starting size from intent and record the assumption; dimensions alone do not identify a channel's current safe area … Confirm supplied placement specs before promising channel compliance.

Direction validation may report a caller-selected native-copy review profile. Use its explicit display-width assumption … Its minimum is a technical rejection floor, not the target type scale … A feed profile is unsuitable for print; record that mismatch instead of changing units to evade it.
note: Third home of the review-profile rule (E2, E4).

text: Placement examples table: square 1080×1080, portrait 1080×1350, story 1080×1920, landscape 1200×628, personal cover 1584×396, company cover 1128×191, display 300×250 / 728×90 / 160×600, A4 210×297mm (see print-geometry.md).
Declare a real page and measured frames before image generation … do not treat print millimeters as pixel coordinates. Keep editable source copy, identity, product images and generated art separate.

Recompose across aspect ratios instead of uniformly scaling a finished ad. Keep the direction's important visual relationships while remeasuring headline lines, support, labels and any CTA … A vertical version need not become a fixed three-beat ladder.

Adapt each message group as a unit using components.md. Reflow the real words at the new width before placing dependent elements … generous whitespace elsewhere does not require a large gap inside a closely related message.
Render and inspect both the whole composition and its intended display size … body copy remains usable rather than merely clearing a technical minimum.

Use a placement-specific overlay or supplied safe-area specification when available … Do not apply a universal bottom mask, fixed content band, or inherited social-safe-margin percentage to every format. Without verified overlay evidence, record the assumption and preserve practical breathing room.

Protect logo clearspace, the product detail named in copy, attribution and action legibility … essential pixels must survive the intended crop … a within-bounds scene alone does not prove a good or platform-safe placement.
